name: pandorium-search-audit
description: Audit supplied HTML and optional response-header and robots snapshots for evidence-backed search eligibility and on-page remediation priorities.

interface.longDescription: Audit a user-supplied HTML snapshot, canonical source URL, and optional response-header and robots.txt snapshots. The bundled offline helper checks directive eligibility, canonical resolution, core page metadata, headings, JSON-LD parsing and types, selected-crawler robots rules, same-origin links, and CTA evidence. Results distinguish observed failures from missing evidence and do not claim live indexing, rankings, AI citations, keyword demand, runtime behavior, or revenue impact.
capabilities: Audit supplied HTML snapshots without network access
Check search directives and canonical resolution
Inspect metadata, headings, JSON-LD, links, and CTA evidence
Return bounded JSON and actionable Markdown findings
defaultPrompt: Audit my HTML snapshot for search eligibility and remediation priorities.
Review these HTML, header, and robots snapshots for search blockers.
